_meta.note: Vectors integrated into primitives, transformations, forces, and noise

navigation.description: How the player moves through the game
rules: The Lab is the central hub. All sequences start and end here.
The last map in every sequence returns the player to the Lab.
On return to Lab, new teleporters appear based on completed sequences.
Spine sequences unlock the next spine sequence teleporter.
Branch sequences unlock from their parent (spine or branch).
Branch completions can unlock further branch sequences (chain unlocks).
The player discovers the full curriculum by completing sequences and returning to see what opened.
navigation.teleporter_logic: Defined by branch_points + branch_chains. Spine progression is linear (order field). On completing sequence X, all sequences listed in X's unlocks appear as new Lab teleporters.

lab_evolution.description: How the Lab changes at each spine completion. Extracted from actual Lab post-map files. The Lab is the hub: every sequence ends here, and new teleporters appear based on completions. Note: post_randomness shares the same layout expansion as post_wavefunctions.
lab_evolution.note_on_implicit_design: Each post-map is a FULL lab layout, not a delta. The system loads the appropriate post-map based on the latest completed sequence. Teleporters listed here are what's present in each post-map file.
